scientific.integrity: The source's full open PDF was inspected through the model equations, reproduction number, Theorem 1, global comparison, and numerical parameter set. The repair is analytic; the bundled checker verifies only algebra and exact arithmetic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The proof treats the strict threshold R0<1 for the normalized Pan–Tang model with 0<rho<1 and alpha>beta. It does not analyze the critical threshold, the endemic equilibrium, or the empirical forecasting section.

title: Risk-composition contraction repairs the global disease-free threshold in a two-susceptibility SLEIRS model
